title: Erol Walker - Better Feature / Feature Dub

lines.l: Ever since my life begun, Mama told me that Jamaicans are our one.
That's why I can't see why we fight among ourselves, why rob and shoot and kill one another.
We must learn to live in this society with one home, one will, we're one people.
